correctness.rationale: Independent exact reconstruction confirms inverse, primitivity, unique illegal turn AB and K4,3 stable graph. The previously invalid inference from 13 taken turns is replaced by the universal f^6 cancellation-state proof: all possible negative continuations lead to exactly six comparable-suffix states; their graph is acyclic; all 19 terminal mismatches are legal. Positive continuations are automatically legal by opposite signs. Arms terminating at interior points are also included because truncation either precedes a mismatch and leaves one legal suffix, or preserves an already legal mismatch. The pINP two-legal-arm structure then rules out every period, not only bounded words. Pfaff FIC and standard no-pINP ageometric/ideal-graph results imply the final classification.
